name: Hurtful Words
overview: Scripture emphasizes the power of words to either harm or heal, urging believers to guard their tongues from evil and deceit. The psalmist prays that both speech and heart meditations be pleasing to God, reflecting a pure and renewed spirit. Proverbs contrasts destructive, hurtful speech with the healing words of the wise, highlighting that gentle answers can defuse anger while harsh words provoke it. Together, these verses call Christians to speak with wisdom and love, honoring God through their words.
